title: Antibody Mastermix Creation
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create antibody volume CSV
steps.instruction: Prepare a .csv file that includes a header line and rows with columns “Volume per antibody (in µl)”, “Antibody”, and “Well”. Example rows: 2.2,CD3 BUV395,A1; 1.1,CD45 BUV496,A3; 1.1,CD15 BUV563,A5; 1.1,CD45RA BUV615,A7; 2.2,CD14 BUV661,A9; 0.55,CD8 BUV737,A11; 2.2,CD11c BUV805,B2; 1.1,CD25 BV421,B4; 0.55,CD4 BV480,B6; 2.2,CD16 BV605,B8; 2.2,CD123 BV650,B10; 2.2,CD127 BV711,B12; 2.2,IgD BV750,C1; 2.2,CD304 BV786,C3; 2.2,CD141 BB515,C5. Empty lines are ignored.

steps.title: Gather labware and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: VWR 96‑well deep‑well plate 2.2 ml (#10755‑250); VWR conical self‑standing tubes 5 ml (#89497‑740) placed in an Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack with a 3 × 5 insert; VWR screw‑cap microcentrifuge tubes 1.5 ml placed in an Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack with a 4 × 6 insert; Opentrons P300 GEN1 single‑channel pipette; Opentrons P10 GEN1 single‑channel pipette; Opentrons 300 µL tip rack; Opentrons 10 µL tip rack.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol interface, input the mount side for the P300 pipette, the mount side for the P10 pipette, the total number of samples to process, and upload the antibody .csv file prepared in step 1.

steps.title: Download protocol script
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol script (or the provided .py file) to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, create a new protocol, and upload the downloaded protocol script.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the deep‑well plate, conical tubes, microcentrifuge tubes, tip racks, and any other required labware on the robot deck exactly as indicated by the protocol’s deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware and for both the P300 and P10 pipettes, following on‑screen prompts and using calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the automated transfer of the specified antibody volumes from the deep‑well plate to the mastermix tube(s) as defined in the CSV file.
